items.difficulty_reason: 6 行陈述（8 行证明）、DVR 基上构造映射满：首句归约已收卡 get-cycles；直接证明 generic 纤维有限展开 + 闭包构造，末步等式靠 generic 纤维唯一性一步带过（软点注记收，uniqueness-extension 文内已收可 chase）。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-get-cycles-dvr (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1233-1238

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Immediate from the general get-cycles lemma; directly, a relative cycle is determined by its generic fibre, so writing the generic fibre as a finite sum of prime cycles and taking the closures in X as in the specialization section reproduces the cycle as the corresponding sum of the closed subscheme constructions (source lines 1240-1247)
